title: Red-Teaming Text-to-Image Systems by Rule-based Preference Modeling
reasoning: The paper presents a framework for red-teaming (adversarial safety testing) of text-to-image systems. While it includes 'discrimination' and 'violence' as categories for evaluation, its primary focus is on the technical security of safety filters and bypassing defense mechanisms rather than evaluating religious representation, spiritual values, moral philosophy, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
